bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · back below the 10-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 重新跌破 10 日均线

read.en: Nvidia fell 1.2% on Oct 28 to $215.38, trading between $214.47 and $219.99. It is just above the falling 5-day ($214.50) and 100-day ($214.51) and the rising 200-day ($204.14), and below the falling 10-day ($215.94) and 30-day ($224.44). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($224.47), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: 英伟达 10月28日下跌 1.2%，收于 $215.38，盘中区间 $214.47–219.99。股价略高于下行的 5 日（$214.50）和 100 日均线（$214.51）以及上行的 200 日均线（$204.14），低于下行的 10 日（$215.94）和 30 日均线（$224.44）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$224.47），RSI 为 44。

read.en: The $220 high was rejected again above $218.9–219.2 and the close slipped back below the 10-day, breaking the $215.5 support. Resistance is $215.9–220 (10-day, Oct 28 high), then $222.2 (Oct 21 high) and $224.4–224.5 (30-day, SAR). Support is $214.5 (5 and 100-day, Oct 28 low), then $210.2–211.3 (Oct 22–23 lows) and $207.3–208.9. A close above $220 would target $222–224.5; below $214.5, $210–211.
